scopeAudit.rootUnion: A species is selected once when any declared COL root occurs in its lineage; nested roots are not additive.

queries.currentSpecies:
WITH RECURSIVE descendants(tsn) AS (
  SELECT ?1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.tsn FROM taxonomic_units u JOIN descendants d ON u.parent_tsn = d.tsn
  WHERE u.name_usage = 'valid'
)
SELECT u.tsn, l.completename AS scientific_name, u.name_usage, u.credibility_rtng,
  u.completeness_rtng, u.currency_rating, u.update_date
FROM descendants d
JOIN taxonomic_units u ON u.tsn = d.tsn
JOIN taxon_unit_types r ON r.kingdom_id = u.kingdom_id AND r.rank_id = u.rank_id
JOIN longnames l ON l.tsn = u.tsn
WHERE lower(trim(r.rank_name)) = 'species' AND u.name_usage = 'valid'
ORDER BY u.tsn
queries.speciesSynonyms:
WITH RECURSIVE descendants(tsn) AS (
  SELECT ?1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.tsn FROM taxonomic_units u JOIN descendants d ON u.parent_tsn = d.tsn
  WHERE u.name_usage = 'valid'
), accepted(tsn) AS (
  SELECT u.tsn FROM descendants d
  JOIN taxonomic_units u ON u.tsn = d.tsn
  JOIN taxon_unit_types r ON r.kingdom_id = u.kingdom_id AND r.rank_id = u.rank_id
  WHERE lower(trim(r.rank_name)) = 'species' AND u.name_usage = 'valid'
)
SELECT s.tsn AS synonym_tsn, sl.completename AS synonym_name, su.name_usage AS synonym_usage,
  su.unaccept_reason, su.update_date AS synonym_update_date, s.tsn_accepted
FROM synonym_links s
JOIN accepted a ON a.tsn = s.tsn_accepted
JOIN taxonomic_units su ON su.tsn = s.tsn
JOIN taxon_unit_types sr ON sr.kingdom_id = su.kingdom_id AND sr.rank_id = su.rank_id
JOIN longnames sl ON sl.tsn = su.tsn
WHERE lower(trim(sr.rank_name)) = 'species'
ORDER BY s.tsn, s.tsn_accepted

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages may publish only the descriptor and canonical file hashes; no row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and every listed row-level shard byte-for-byte.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: Data-only import; no version, package manifest or release-manifest changes.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, fixed COL and ITIS roots, exact SQL, representation-only normalization, Unicode code-unit ID ordering and deterministic gzip; no fuzzy matching.
